title: Wall Street Giant JPMorgan Quietly Exploring Crypto Trading for Institutional Clients: Report
summary: JPMorgan has explored institutional crypto trading, weighing spot and derivatives while building blockchain rails. The bank has tokenized a money-market fund on Ethereum and structured a Solana bond for Galaxy Digital as Wall Street peers plan trading rollouts in 2026. Plans hinge on client demands. The post Wall Street Giant JPMorgan Quietly Exploring Crypto Trading for Institutional Clients: Report appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: Families of Palestine Action hunger strikers seek urgent meeting with Lammy
summary: Some protesters are now seriously ill after weeks without food as justice secretary is urged to show some humanity Families and supporters of Palestine Action-affiliated hunger strikers have pleaded with David Lammy to meet them in an attempt to end the impasse over the protest that has left some of them severely unwell. On Monday, as the protest reached a dangerous stage, lawyers for the hunger strikers sent a legal letter claiming that by refusing a meeting the justice secretary had failed to comply with the Ministry of Justice’s (MoJ’s) own policy on handling of hunger strikes. title: Canada Post and union representing workers reach tentative agreement, agree not to strike
summary: The tentative agreement comes after the two parties first agreed to a deal in principle last month. Today's agreement finalizes "contractual language" and will prevent either side from locking workers out or striking, ahead of the busy holiday season.
